mission.title: Why SokoPlus?
mission.text: SokoPlus is a B2B/B2C marketplace purpose-built for Tanzania and East Africa. It connects industrial buyers with verified vendors, service providers and delivery partners across all 31 regions — with verified sellers, QR-coded delivery verification and bilingual support from day one.
